referenceStatus: Fixed V5 source reconstruction including later patches; not a target2016 executable measurement.

retention.evaluation: At actual resurrection, after the host has accepted current score changes; not at death or at a later presentation phase.
retention.mpEvidence: X2GUUser.cpp:1954-1968 PVP_SEASON2 ReInit explicitly sets MP0 for lead>1 and halves MP for lead1; all other gaps leave its current value.
retention.specialResourceEvidence: Project-specific resource extension. No acquired fixed V5 seasonal special-resource penalty is asserted.
retention.consumption: Capture registered balances before clean-template replacement, restore once with the revival factor; alive players cannot be revived again.

awakening.orbs: Preserve. X2GUUser::ReInit:1701 saves GetHyperModeCount;2126 restores SetHyperModeCount.
awakening.gauge: Preserve by static source inference. GameUnit.h:2313-2316 delegates Soul to the persistent GageData; GageData.h:332-342 separates m_SoulGage.fNow from fMax. SetMaxSoul100 only writes fMax; GameUnit::ReInit:666-796 does not recreate/initialize GageData. GUUser::ReInit writes SetNowSoul0 only in the old non-PVP_SEASON2 #else branch:1973/1978, not the selected seasonal branch.
awakening.activeTime: Clear independently. GameUnit::ReInit:679 sets remaining hypermode time0. This is not a score penalty.
awakening.initialGauge: User-selected50 with zero orbs only at match start; resurrection never grants this initial bonus again.

ravenCore.evidence: X2GURaven::ReInit:402-425 under UPGRADE_RAVEN unconditionally clears core level at417 and rage gauge at418. Core reset is an independent lifecycle, regardless of score.

specialResourceRegistration.api: PvpMatch constructor specialResourcePools: [{ id, read(actor), write(actor,value) }]
specialResourceRegistration.id: Unique lowercase ASCII /^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/; mp, awakening and core are reserved and rejected.
specialResourceRegistration.read: Host-authored callback returns a finite nonnegative balance, or null when this actor has no supported pool. Invalid balances fail before actor replacement.
specialResourceRegistration.write: Host-authored callback restores the captured retained balance on the replacement actor. Must be synchronous, deterministic and must not throw for its declared supported pool.
specialResourceRegistration.configuration: Provider records and ID list are copied and frozen; snapshot carries IDs and restore requires identical IDs. Provider code is host program behavior, not serialized state.
specialResourceRegistration.network: No actor.specialResources field or new wire IDs are introduced. Future character support must also implement and validate its codec state and source semantics before registration.
specialResourceRegistration.unregisteredFields: Never iterate arbitrary actor numbers. Only MP, the separately sourced awakening storage, and explicitly registered pools are preserved across the template reset.

evidenceBoundary: Native four-actor and pure controller regressions verify this webpage implementation and source-derived conditions. No original target2016 runtime or GPU trace has been acquired.
